about: sedi-1's holder cases (test-plan item 5, choice holder-presents): each fixture is a bundle in the form acdc_build reads with the held credential expanded unless it says otherwise, and each case names a disclosure and either the body a holder must present, with the secrets it must not carry, or the reason it must refuse. The expectation is the model's (generators/spec_tables/sedi_present.py and sedi_cases.py).

cases.title: Compact presentation
cases.description: H holds a credential issued to it by I, with a salted attribute block, and is asked for the compact form: every block compacted to its SAID. A sedi-1 holder presents exactly that body, carrying none of the attribute block's contents.

cases.title: Expanded presentation
cases.description: As SH-01, but H is asked for the expanded form, every block expanded. A sedi-1 holder presents exactly that body.

cases.title: Partial presentation of the attributes
cases.description: As SH-01, but H is asked to expand the attribute block a and nothing else. A sedi-1 holder presents exactly that body.

cases.title: Partial presentation of one edge
cases.description: N, issued by I to H with an I2I edge le to F, is held by H, which is asked to expand e.le and nothing else. The edge section e is expanded because it contains le, and the attribute block stays compact. A sedi-1 holder presents exactly that body.

cases.title: Selective disclosure of one attribute
cases.description: H holds an aggregate credential issued to it by I whose blinded attribute blocks name the issuee, a name and a city, and is asked to disclose the name only. A sedi-1 holder presents the aggregate with the name block disclosed and the others as their blinded SAIDs, carrying neither the city nor the hidden blocks' salts.

cases.title: Selective disclosure of the issuee and one attribute
cases.description: As SH-05, but H is asked to disclose the issuee block and the name. A sedi-1 holder presents exactly that.

cases.title: Revoked credential
cases.description: As SH-01, but the credential's registry head records it revoked. A verifier would refuse it, so a sedi-1 holder refuses to present it.
cases.triage: Presenting it puts a revoked credential before a verifier as if it stood.

cases.title: Bundle missing the issuer's KEL
cases.description: As SH-01, but the bundle carries none of the issuer's key events, so the credential's commitment cannot be established. A verifier could not find it valid, so a sedi-1 holder refuses to present it.
cases.triage: Presenting it puts before a verifier a credential no one can show was issued.

cases.title: Credential whose issuance a verifier refuses
cases.description: As SH-01, but the registry update that issues the credential is anchored only by a bare digest, which sedi-1 refuses. A verifier would refuse the credential, so a sedi-1 holder refuses to present it.
cases.triage: Presenting it puts before a verifier a credential whose issuance the profile refuses.

cases.title: Path that names nothing
cases.description: As SH-03, but the partial form names ["x"]. A sedi-1 holder refuses, rather than present anything else.
cases.triage: Presenting it discloses what the holder was not asked to disclose, or presents a credential other than the one asked for.

cases.title: Path named twice
cases.description: As SH-03, but the partial form names ["a", "a"]. A sedi-1 holder refuses, rather than present anything else.
cases.triage: Presenting it discloses what the holder was not asked to disclose, or presents a credential other than the one asked for.

cases.title: Empty partial choice
cases.description: As SH-03, but the partial form names []. A sedi-1 holder refuses, rather than present anything else.
cases.triage: Presenting it discloses what the holder was not asked to disclose, or presents a credential other than the one asked for.

cases.title: Path into a block held only compact
cases.description: As SH-03, but H holds the credential with its attribute block compact, so it has no attributes to expand. A sedi-1 holder refuses.
cases.triage: Presenting it discloses what the holder was not asked to disclose, or presents a credential other than the one asked for.
expect: A refused/a names a block held only compact

cases.title: Selective disclosure of a credential with no aggregate
cases.description: As SH-01, but H is asked for a selective disclosure of a credential whose attributes are a plain block a, not an aggregate. A sedi-1 holder refuses.
cases.triage: Presenting it discloses what the holder was not asked to disclose, or presents a credential other than the one asked for.
expect: A refused/a selective form of an ACDC with no aggregate

cases.title: Label that names no block
cases.description: As SH-05, but the selective form names ["nickname"]. A sedi-1 holder refuses, rather than present anything else.
cases.triage: Presenting it discloses what the holder was not asked to disclose, or presents a credential other than the one asked for.
expect: A refused/nickname names no single block

cases.title: Label named twice
cases.description: As SH-05, but the selective form names ["name", "name"]. A sedi-1 holder refuses, rather than present anything else.
cases.triage: Presenting it discloses what the holder was not asked to disclose, or presents a credential other than the one asked for.

cases.title: Empty selective choice
cases.description: As SH-05, but the selective form names []. A sedi-1 holder refuses, rather than present anything else.
cases.triage: Presenting it discloses what the holder was not asked to disclose, or presents a credential other than the one asked for.
